input.summary: Add Corio right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund and no penalty; confirm Commerce One has no convenience right during the term
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a customer right to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, since the agreement otherwise locks us into a five-year term with exit rights only for material breach or insolvency. If helpful we can move to 60 days' notice, but we cannot accept an early-termination fee or a Commerce One convenience right during the committed term.

ops.text: 11.4 Termination for Convenience. Corio may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Commerce One, in which case Commerce One shall refund to Corio any prepaid fees covering the period after the effective date of termination. Corio shall not be liable for any early termination fee, penalty or other charge as a result of such termination. Commerce One shall have no right to terminate this Agreement or any portion thereof for convenience during the initial five (5) year term or any renewal term.
